## The Speed-Quality Paradox

The average time-to-hire in 2026 is 44 days. For specialized roles, it can stretch to 60-90 days. Every day a role stays open costs the business $500-$1,500 in lost productivity.

But rushing to fill seats leads to mis-hires, which cost 30-150% of annual salary to correct. The solution is not hiring faster — it is eliminating waste from the process.

### Where Time Gets Wasted

Our analysis of 10,000+ hiring processes reveals the biggest time sinks:

| Activity | Average Time | Can Be Reduced To |
|---|---|---|
| Requisition approval | 5 days | 1 day |
| Job posting creation | 3 days | Same day |
| Initial sourcing | 14 days | Ongoing pipeline |
| Resume screening | 5 days | 1 day |
| Interview scheduling | 8 days | 2 days |
| Interview rounds | 10 days | 5 days |
| Decision making | 5 days | 2 days |
| Offer preparation | 3 days | Same day |
| **Total** | **53 days** | **~20 days** |

### 10 Tactics to Cut Time in Half

#### 1. Pre-Approved Requisitions

Work with finance to pre-approve headcount for the quarter. Eliminate the 5-day approval loop.

#### 2. Evergreen Job Templates

Maintain ready-to-post templates for recurring roles. Customize in minutes, not days.

#### 3. Always-On Sourcing Pipeline

Want to see this in action?

Start a risk-free pilot for one role. Get a scored shortlist in days with no placement fees.

[Start a pilot](/pilot)
[See how it works](/how-it-works)

Do not wait for a requisition to start sourcing. Maintain warm talent pools by role family. Our subscription model keeps your pipeline flowing continuously.

#### 4. AI-Assisted Resume Screening

Use structured screening criteria and scoring to evaluate applications in hours, not days.

#### 5. Self-Service Interview Scheduling

Tools like Calendly eliminate the back-and-forth. Candidates pick from available slots instantly.

#### 6. Compressed Interview Formats

Replace 5-round marathons with focused 3-step processes:

- 30-min phone screen
- 60-min skills assessment
- 60-min team/culture fit

#### 7. Real-Time Interviewer Feedback

Require scorecards within 2 hours of each interview. Delayed feedback delays decisions.

#### 8. Standing Offer Committee

Designate decision-makers in advance. No waiting for schedules to align.

#### 9. Pre-Built Offer Packages

Work with HR and legal to create templatized offers by role level. Customize specifics, not frameworks.

#### 10. Same-Day Verbal Offers

When you find the right candidate, extend a verbal offer the same day as the final interview. Follow with written within 24 hours.

### The TaaS Speed Advantage

- Weekly candidate drops mean sourcing never pauses
- Pre-scored candidates eliminate screening time
- Fit notes help interviewers prepare in minutes
- Ranked shortlists accelerate decision-making
